### Checklist:
<!--
  Please go through the following checklist to the best of your abilities before submitting your performance report.
  After submitting, click on the checkboxes to mark them as completed.
-->
- [ ] I checked [on this page](https://github.com/Sv443/BetterYTM/issues?q=is%3Aissue+sort%3Aupdated-desc) if someone already reported the same issue.
- [ ] I am using the latest version of BetterYTM (matching [the latest release](https://github.com/Sv443/BetterYTM/releases/latest)).
- [ ] I am using a recent version of my browser.
- [ ] I can reproduce the bug while ***all*** my other extensions and userscripts are disabled.
- [ ] I attached a performance report to this issue.
